title: From Augmentation to Reconstruction: Guiding the AI Disruption to the Good Place
abstract: arXiv:2605.29207v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Artificial intelligence feels omnipresent, yet the disruption many expect has not fully arrived. The main reason is not model capability, nor even the tools built to harness those models. Rather, most organizations are still using AI to accelerate workflows designed for a pre-AI world. We offer a three-stage lens: Augmentation, Automation, and Reconstruction, and argue that the most consequential disruption resides in the third stage where workflows and markets are rebuilt around delegation, machine-to-machine interaction, continuous monitoring, and auditable constraints. translated_title: 从增强到重构：引导人工智能变革走向美好未来
translated_abstract: 人工智能似乎无处不在，然而人们所期待的那场颠覆却尚未完全到来。主要原因不在于模型能力，也不在于为驾驭这些模型而构建的工具，而在于大多数组织仍在使用人工智能来加速为“前AI时代”设计的工作流程。我们提出了一个三阶段视角：增强、自动化与重构，并论证最具深远影响的颠覆存在于第三阶段——在这一阶段，工作流程和市场将围绕任务委托、机器与机器的交互、持续监控以及可审计的约束条件而重新构建。实现这种系统层面的变革需要时间：它需要信任与问责基础设施、机器可读且可互操作的数据与接口、这些新工作流程的设计与采纳，以及有利于重构而非局部优化的经济激励——正是这些互补性投资造就了人们熟知的“生产率J曲线”。
tldr: 本文提出“增强—自动化—重构”三阶段框架，指出AI颠覆尚未完全到来是因为组织仍在用AI加速旧有流程，真正的变革在于围绕任务委托、机机交互与可审计约束对工作流程和市场进行系统性重构。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a three-stage framework—Augmentation, Automation, and Reconstruction—arguing that the AI disruption has not fully arrived because organizations still use AI to accelerate pre-AI workflows, and that the most consequential transformation lies in rebuilding workflows and markets around delegation, machine-to-machine interaction, and auditable constraints.
